---
title: "RSM-MSBA Quarto test"
format: gfm
jupyter: python3
---

This document verifies that **Quarto** renders with the RSM-MSBA Python
environment. Render it from a workspace terminal:

```bash
quarto render examples/quarto_report.qmd
```

It produces `examples/quarto_report.md`. (Quarto also renders to HTML/PDF; `gfm`
is used here so the output is easy to preview on GitHub.)

```{python}
import sys
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

print("python   :", sys.executable)
print("numpy    :", np.__version__)
print("pandas   :", pd.__version__)

df = pd.DataFrame({"x": np.arange(1, 6), "y": np.arange(1, 6) ** 2})
df
```

If `python` above points at `…/.rsm-msba/envs/nix-uv/bin/python`, Quarto is using
the RSM-MSBA environment correctly.
